messages:
devon: Quick follow-up from the postmortem this morning — capturing the remediation owners and a short timeline for the vendor/dependency outages (cloud auth spikes + model-registry flaps). I sketched actions below, please ack and update if you own something.

devon: TL;DR actions: 1) short-term fallback wiring for registry auth, 2) cloud provider retry/backoff tuning + circuit, 3) model-registry health telemetry + cheap canary, 4) quarterly dry-run of fallback + runbook drill.

anya: I can take #1 (registry auth fallback wiring). Will update the repo with the adaptor shim and an integration test. Target: M3 Friday for PR + ops dry-run.

michael: taking #2 (cloud retry + circuit). I'll try conservative backoffs first then add a blackhole detector to trigger fallback. ETA: next Tue for initial tuning, Thu for rollout to staging.

samir: for #3 (registry health telemetry + cheap canary) — got an existing exporter we can adapt. I'll add the canary job to run every 5m and emit latency/p99/403-rate. Plan: prototype in dev by EOW.

claire: I own #4 (quarterly dry-run/runbook drill). I'll schedule the first drill in 3 weeks and run a 60-minute tabletop + 30-minute simulated failover. Adding checklists for SRE/Eng/Support.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: Staging deploy queued for devon/anya: registry-fallback-shim v0.1 on 3032150000

anya: quick note: the fallback shim needs a small config flag to prefer cached model-metadata during registry auth blips. I'll add `REGISTRY_FALLBACK_MODE=read-cache` and tests.

devon: good — can we also add a short-circuit to avoid token refresh storms? If registry auth is failing, clients should stretch token TTL for ~2m.

michael: yes — I'll coordinate token-stretch changes with auth team. @anya please add a hazard note in the PR about TTL behavior.

anya: noted. I'll include a clear rollout plan and feature-flag `registry_fallback_v2` so we can canary it.

samir: telemetry note — we'll emit a synthetic trace when fallback engages so we can correlate spikes with auth errors. Schema: `event=registry_fallback, reason=auth_5xx, canary_id=...`

claire: for the drill agenda: 1) detect auth spike from telemetry, 2) flip feature flag to fallback, 3) validate end-to-end app behavior, 4) measure user-visible error delta. I'll post the invite and required attendees.

devon: owners confirmed. A couple additional asks: - can we set an SLA for ack times on vendor-auth regressions (15m on-call ack)? - add a periodic (monthly) vendor SLA review to the Ops calendar.

michael: ack on 15m. I'll add a PagerDuty escalation policy tweak and ping infra procurement for monthly review.

anya: PR posted: https://git.internal/repo/registry-fallback/pull/42 — contains config, tests, and rollout steps.

samir: prototype telemetry PR: https://git.internal/repo/monitoring/pull/207 — adding fallback metric + synthetic canary job.

devon: thanks. final ask: can each owner add a one-line status to the postmortem doc by EOD Friday? I'll then aggregate into a follow-up tracker and circulate to leadership. :calendar: :white_check_mark:

claire: will do. scheduling invite in a few minutes. :wave:

sre-bot: reminder: Create incident follow-up ticket for "auth-provider-regression-mitigation" assigned to devon, anya, michael, samir, claire (due 2026-05-10).

michael: added the ticket and included PR links + timeline. https://tickets.internal/INC-5891

devon: perfect. closing loop here — if anyone needs to shift timelines ping me directly. I'll update the postmortem with these owners and expected dates.
